blogs.title: Beyond Low-Rank: Why Rotating Neurons Beats Adding Them for AI Image Customization
blogs.description: An accessible deep dive into 'Orthogonal Finetuning' (OFT), explaining how rotating the internal mathematical angles of a neural network preserves the magic of pre-trained models better than traditional methods like LoRA. We explore why maintaining the 'hyperspherical energy'—the relationships between neurons—is the secret sauce to keeping your AI from forgetting how to draw realistic humans while learning specific new styles.

blogs.title: DreamBooth on Steroids: Generating Your Pet in Any Scene Without Model Collapse
blogs.description: Struggling with subject-driven generation where your custom pet looks distorted or the background ignores your text prompt? This post breaks down how OFT solves the stability issues plaguing tools like DreamBooth. Learn how this new technique allows you to fine-tune massive image generators with fewer training steps, preventing the common 'model collapse' where images turn into gibberish after too many iterations.

blogs.title: Total Control, Zero Lag: Mastering Controllable Image Generation with COFT
blogs.description: Discover how Constrained Orthogonal Finetuning (COFT) gives artists precise control over image generation using sketches, edge maps, or segmentation masks. We compare OFT against heavyweights like ControlNet and T2I-Adapter, highlighting its ability to converge faster with less data and, crucially, run at the exact same speed as the base model without any extra inference overhead.
